character.description: A lean side-view wandering samurai with a weathered indigo haori, tied topknot, light lamellar shoulder armor, cloth waist sash, and a katana-like blade. He should read as disciplined, dangerous, and human-sized for a side-scrolling action game.
character.style_notes: Dark fantasy 2D pixel-art for a side-scrolling action game. Clean silhouette, grounded stances, readable anticipation and recovery, limited muted palette, no mascot proportions, no decorative glow.

animations.prompt: calm combat breathing stance, hand near the sword, subtle cloth movement
side-view running right, compact stride, grounded samurai footwork
quick katana slash with clear anticipation, committed swing, and readable recovery
short decisive katana deflection pose, compact body turn, tiny hard-edged blade contact highlight only
blade raised in guarded defensive stance, feet planted, posture tight
quick low evasive dash to the right, body compressed, strong forward commitment
short action-game jump arc, readable takeoff and airborne silhouette
brief recoil from impact, controlled but painful
readable collapse to the ground, serious and grounded, not gory
